meta.description: Runs JACKS joint CRISPR knockout-screen analysis, estimating per-gene condition effects and shared per-sgRNA efficacy, with guidance for priors, diagnostics, failure modes, and alternatives.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All quantitative results in this report came from saved live runs. JACKS outputs and documented headers matched the installed JACKS 0.2 behavior.

practice_boundaries.detail: This is a computational CRISPR-screen analysis Skill with no diagnostic, patient-specific, or treatment-prescriptive output.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill distinguishes same-library/same-chemistry use, warns against wrong reffiles, treats p-values as pseudo-gene based, and uses effect/posterior-std rather than guide X2 as the gene statistic.

code_usability.detail: All three copied executable artifacts compiled. The Python API, documented CLI, wrapper, plotting, and efficacy-summary paths ran against real JACKS example-small and HAP1 data.

functional_suitability.note: The tested branch covers joint runs, CLI and API use, priors, diagnostics, convergence, and tool selection with existing files.

reliability.note: Expected malformed-library and guide-map cases stop with actionable errors; the wrapper resolves caller-relative paths. It could preflight input paths before spawning JACKS.

performance_context.note: The 173-line core delegates detail to three focused references and two runnable helpers without redundant workflow text.

agent_usability.note: Parameters, file headers, output semantics, decision boundaries, and deliberate-use overrides are consistent across the core, guide, and scripts.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts and a concrete workflow are clear; one usage-guide reference still names a section as though it were in SKILL.md rather than its reference file.

security.note: No credentials, shell interpolation, or destructive operations occur; wrapper path arguments are passed list-form but not preflight-validated.

maintainability.note: References and scripts separate efficacy diagnostics, failure modes, and comparisons; all declared executable artifacts compile and were exercised.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggers, progressive disclosure, related-skill seams, deterministic rerun guidance, and explicit cases for MAGeCK, BAGEL2, and Chronos are present.

inputs.label: Joint example-small API analysis with default and hierarchical-prior variant
inputs.execution_note: Saved input1 script ran both settings on 8,081 guides and 1,579 genes; rho range was 0.894-0.960.
inputs.note: Default uses apply_w_hp=False as documented and the variant produces materially different rankings.

assertions.text: Canonical API call completes on real bundled data

assertions.note: All five rho values were below 1.
Gene and guide result files parsed.
Values came from saved output files.

inputs.label: HAP1 TKOv3 single-screen CLI run and essentiality benchmark
inputs.execution_note: Saved input2 script invoked run_JACKS.py from JACKS/jacks on 18,056 genes; effect AUC 0.9960 and z AUC 0.9951.
inputs.note: The corrected CLI location and output interpretation work on a large real screen.

assertions.text: Known essentials appear among top hits

assertions.note: AUC was calculated from this run.

inputs.label: Wrong-library reference efficacy prior
inputs.execution_note: Saved input3 script passed an example-small reffile to HAP1 and captured the expected missing-sgRNA exception.
inputs.note: The error is expected and validates the documented hard-stop failure mode.

assertions.text: Prior schema is accepted up to guide validation

inputs.label: Shipped downstream analysis, plot, and efficacy diagnostic
inputs.execution_note: Saved input4 script ran copied examples/run_jacks.py analysis and plot plus the documented efficacy diagnostic.
inputs.note: 1,579 genes, 8,081 guides, 266 effect/std hits, and a 93,990-byte PNG were produced.

inputs.label: Documented CRISPRi prior override and restoration
inputs.execution_note: Saved input5 script ran the functools.partial override, restored the original callable, and reran default inference.
inputs.note: Posterior efficacy SD widened 0.557 to 0.763 and the restored result matched default.

inputs.label: Partial sgRNA naming mismatch
inputs.execution_note: Saved input6 script corrupted 594/1,187 guide-map identifiers on a 300-gene HAP1 subset and ran the CLI.
inputs.note: The run returned 299 rather than 300 genes with zero NaNs, matching the documented symptom.

assertions.text: Mismatched names do not fabricate NaNs

inputs.label: Determinism, iteration override, and p-value gating
inputs.execution_note: Saved input7 script reran default inference twice, ran n_iter=500, and exercised n_pseudo 0 versus 2000.
inputs.note: Default runs matched, n_iter default was 50, and only n_pseudo=2000 produced a p-value file.

inputs.label: Fresh reffile output-contract and same-ID wrong-value test
inputs.execution_note: Fresh saved input8 script ran a matched reffile and an all-ID-matched shuffled-value reffile.
inputs.note: Matched reffile omitted both logfoldchange files; shuffled values were silently accepted and changed 3,859 effect cells by more than 0.1.

inputs.label: Fresh caller-relative wrapper and shipped summary CLI
inputs.execution_note: Fresh saved input9 script built the required Control column, called the copied wrapper with relative paths, then invoked copied efficacy_summary.py with --out.
inputs.note: Wrapper returned True; the summary CLI emitted 8,081-guide metrics and a parseable 1,579-row TSV.

key_strengths: Nine real executions cover every prior regression input plus two fresh paths.
The core workflow, CLI, API, wrapper, diagnostics, convergence override, and reffile branches all produced checked outputs.
Documentation distinguishes output schemas, chemistry/library limits, and appropriate alternative tools.
The branch stayed at the dispatched commit and source worktree remained clean during the audit.
